sys.path.insert(0,'submission')

random.seed(5)
for mode in ['route','admit']:
 for Bmax in [0,1e3,1e5,1e6]:
  E=64;K=24
  caps=[random.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(E)]
  dem=[1000]*K
  paths=[]
  for k in range(K):
   pp=[]
   for j in range(4):pp.append(random.sample(range(E),12))
   paths.append(pp)
  B=[random.uniform(-Bmax,Bmax) for _ in range(E)]
  t0=time.time()
  for it in range(48):
   res=solve_worker(caps,dem,paths,list(range(K)),mode,8,B)
   assert res['status']=='optimal'
  print(mode,Bmax,(time.time()-t0)/48,'s per solve')
